description: Creates a zero-credit API key, returned once and not shown again. When the response says connection_authenticated, this MCP session already uses the key; other connections authenticate with an HTTP Authorization: Bearer header. No arguments. For OAuth-capable clients, a Connect prompt appears automatically the first time an account or paid tool is called, with no website account needed, so no key is required.
name: create_guest_key
title: Create Accountless API Key
